description: Variation of condition 2 (Heritage Statement) to allow specific type of brick - that of Imperial Soot-washed Weathered Soft Red, to be replaced with Hampshire Red, Medium Renovation, a Charnwood Imperial sized brick following planning permission 00505/BV/L15 dated 17/04/2019 for construction of two step free access lift towers connecting the existing passenger footbridge with the platforms and associated works (Listed Building Consent application with Prior Approval under Schedule 2 Part 18 Class A of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development)(England) Order 2015 (as amended)
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Osterley Step Free Access Heritage Statement and Sample of Materials) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - During the works a full record shall be made (and annotated, including photographs), and kept with the approved drawings and background research material in a log book and a copy of which shall be lodged with the local planning authority within one month after the works hereby approved are completed.
